versions.content: Transmission PDU states Status: DRAFT The V2xGn module shall maintain a separate state for each transmission PDU used by the V2xGn module (V2xGnTxPdu) and distinguish at least the following states: • PDU_AVAILABLE : The PDU for a specific transmission is available and ready to be used (PDU resources are released) • PDU_IN_USE : The PDU for a specific transmission is not available and is already used (PDU resources are valid)
